defects.D1: offer shape deals→mandate: deals.pay passes the seller offer {prices:{...}} to mandate.decide, which reads offer.asset/offer.amount, so every honest pay() is QUOTE_MISMATCH (integrator fix in bank/deals.py)
defects.D2: dispute timer and dispute API not merged (stream U: bank/deadlines.py, dispute decisions; N13/N14/S05)
defects.D3: Tatum webhook /webhooks/tatum not built (L7): no HMAC check, no dedupe by txId
defects.D4: VAT-ack mark lost: deals.pay replaces mandate.decide's marks with the reserve() result, and there is no human ack-vat endpoint yet (integrator fix in bank/deals.py + bank/api.py)
defects.D5: seller injection mode keeps an honest 402: the injected 50 EURC to 0xdEaD never reaches the quote (integrator fix in seller/app.py)
defects.D6: verifier.settlement accepts a keyword-less item on the judge's 'plausible' alone, so words in a delivered item can get it paid (MOCK judge); evals only (integrator's verifier change holds such items for a human)
